name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Chile, he initially worked in the banking sector. However, his passion for Formula One, ignited in his youth by watching Ayrton Senna race, never faded. He began volunteering his IT skills at a local karting track, eventually leading to a full-time role managing their timing and data systems. From there, he moved up the ranks, gaining experience with various racing teams before joining Vee Masters.

Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach to IT infrastructure. He believes in building robust, scalable systems that can handle the pressures of a fast-paced racing environment. His focus is on ensuring data integrity and minimizing downtime, critical for race strategy and performance analysis. He's also passionate about leveraging new technologies to gain a competitive edge. Ricardo's ability to stay calm and focused even under immense pressure makes him an invaluable asset to the Vee Masters team, allowing him to troubleshoot problems swiftly and effectively.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even during meetings.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard with loud, clicky keys, much to the annoyance of his colleagues.
